_about: Curated OddsPapi participant id -> liiga.fi teamId map (docs/ODDS_PLAN.md Phase 2). Every entry is backed by at least one saved board fixture whose home/away pair matched exactly one hockey.db game at that start time. Add a team only with the same kind of evidence. HIFK 3839 and Karpat 3835 were confirmed 2026-09-17 when they first appeared on a board, the same way. Still absent until seen: HPK (3837?) -- OddsPapi lists 2-3 ids per name for each, so a guess could silently map a junior/women's side.
